method: Unmodified standard viewer global Terrarium field; bilinear interpolation at pixel centers in the signed building frame. No flattening. Twelve-meter whole-barrier sampling retains the standard regional terrain without flattening;not surveyed dam or machinery levels.
attribution: Mapzen/Terrain Tiles; NASA/USGS and other open elevation sources
limitations: Approximate global viewer terrain; not surveyed urban foundation levels. Vegetation and urban surface returns can affect the field.
